## Transcript

Thank you so much for attending my
PowerPoint presentation on how to
counter every hero in Dota 2.
So the rule is that we're going to try
to avoid saying BKB unless it's a hero
that you absolutely need to buy BKB
against and there's no other suitable
counters. So Abaddon, Eul's is a really
good pick up for him because you can use
it during his ultimate to stall it out.
Aphotic Shield is also dispellable so if
you want you can use it to dispel
Aphotic Shield, but that's a very
specific use. Mostly just save it for
his ulti. Alchemist relies quite a bit
on the regen that he gets from his
ultimate, but if you have any way of
dealing with that, some form of
anti-heal, it's very good. Spirit Vessel
is probably the most accessible option
for supports, but Shiva's Guard and
Skadi are also good pick ups. He will
still hit like a truck though, so try to
keep your distance.
Ancient Apparition is one of many heroes
in Dota 2 to sport what I like to call a
frail little [ __ ] body. So the real
solution to him is to just jump him
early on in the fight and try to deal
with him before he gets his ultimate
off. Blink Dagger is an excellent choice
for that, but Force Staff, maybe some
heroes have innate movement abilities
that you use those instead. You get the
idea. Once he has his full combo
together, it's very easy for Anti-Mage
to drain you dry before you even know
what's going on. So having a Magic Wand
to be able to get one or two spells off
is ideal. This also works very well in
the laning stage for the same reason, so
be sure to get it early. Hurricane Pike
isn't exactly in fashion on this hero
anymore, so Harpoon is a really good way
to deal with the bubble. If you're a
ranged hero, you can go for an MKB, but
a Harpoon is very funny because it pulls
him either out of the bubble or you into
it and both are humorous solutions to
the problem that is this hero.
Seeing an enemy Axe jump on three of
your teammates and hitting call is
terrifying, but if you have a Eul's
Scepter you can make them all stare up
at him like that blue tinted image of
Willem Dafoe. All of Bane's kit is unit
target and the majority of it is
dispellable, so throw a Lotus Orb on
whatever core looks the most vulnerable.
Bonus points if Bane uses his ultimate
on a Lotus Orb target and it cancels
itself after a millisecond. Batrider is
extremely reliant on using Napalm stacks
to deal damage with both his right
clicks and his abilities. So if you have
a way to dispel it, it's an excellent
option. Manta is probably for the best
because if you use something like
Satanic or BKB, he can still use Flaming
Lasso on you. Beastmaster is kind of
tough, but if you want to go a single
item as a carry to counter him, Mjolnir
is probably your best bet. If he's going
the Helm of the Dominator build, he
wants to use his ultimate and then smack
you down with all of his poopers, but
Mjolnir and the active from it will
usually kill them before they're able to
kill you. All right, this one's a
classic. So Rupture is a very strong
spell, but Bloodseeker has no innate
stun. So if he catches you out in the
lane farming alone and starts with his
ultimate, you can just teleport your way
out of there and there's really nothing
he can do about it. Obviously this
doesn't apply if he decides to go Basher
or god forbid a Eul's, but hopefully
that won't happen. Now Bounty Hunter
players in their infinite wisdom will
often stay invisible near someone in the
jungle and just spam track on them
whenever they can. If this happens and
you're relatively confident you know
where the Bounty is, just pop dust and
he can no longer run away from you. I
thought about putting Hand of Midas here
since it'll let you recoup all of the
gold that he steals, but to be honest in
this meta that item is completely
useless. Now Brewmaster is another hero
that isn't really countered by any one
item in particular. I thought about
putting an Orchid or a Scythe of Vyse
here, but really those counter everyone
to a certain degree. Instead, I say you
go for a Manta Style. During his
ultimate he's got four little dudes to
manage and there's no way he's going to
be able to pay attention to which one of
you is real. If you movement bait one of
your illusions away and he cast Tornado
on it, congratulations, you've made him
look the fool.
If you hit Bristleback with Silver Edge,
he dies.
That's really all I have to say.
Broodmother is another hero who is
countered more by play style and hero
abilities than items, but Mjolnir can
help you in some ways. If he sends all
the spiderlings on you when you pop the
Mjolnir active, they'll probably kill
themselves before they're able to deal
any meaningful damage to you. Now
Centaur Warrunner's chief gimmick is the
fact that he takes forever to kill and
because of Return, you're going to be
dealing damage to yourself with every
right click. Satanic helps you deal with
that both enabling you to sustain his
initial stun with Hoof Stomp, but it
also allows you to keep wailing on him
even if Return is dealing a little bit
of damage back. Other forms of life
steal like Vlad's also can work. Now
CK's illusions do a ridiculous amount of
damage, but the cost of this is that
they also take a ridiculous amount of
damage. If you have a Battle Fury and a
decent amount of damage, you can get rid
of them with just a few well-placed
right clicks, but this assumes that he
hasn't killed you first. Anyone playing
in the current meta will be well aware
of the fact that Dagon does not work on
Helm of the Dominator creeps because
they work as creep heroes. Chen's
creeps, however, get no such privilege
and if you have a Dagon, you can use it
to deal with the creeps before they're
able to stack up too heavily and slowly
wear down your tier two towers with a
bunch of shitty little skeletons. Now
because his kit is entirely physical
damage, armor is usually what I would
suggest against Clinkz, but if he's
going for the devilish split push build,
picking up BOTs when you don't
necessarily have to can go a long way
towards mitigating the impact he has on
your buildings. Getting caught in Power
Cogs freaking sucks and getting ran down
by Battery Assault almost freaking sucks
as hard. Force Staff will get you out of
both situations, forcing yourself out of
the Cogs and putting some distance
between you and the clock. The effects
from both Crystal Maiden's Q and W are
dispellable, which means that items like
Manta Style can work, but I think
Satanic is actually the best thing
because it allows you to sit there and
man fight her during her ultimate. Now
Ion Shell is solidly Dark Seer's most
annoying ability during the lane, but
afterwards I think Surge actually takes
the throne as the biggest thorn in your
side coming out of his kit. Eul's
Scepter will allow you to dispel Surge
and keep him in place and when he
finally hits the ground, you can rip
this purple [ __ ] apart. Of all the
position fours in Dota 2 that deal way
too much damage, Dark Willow is
definitely one of them. However, while
she can
dish out quite a bit, she really can't
take all that Blade Mail and watch as
she kills herself on Bedlam because if
there's one thing Dark Willows don't do,
it's give up on a potential solo kill.
If you can't go back in time and pick
Nyx Assassin or Silencer to get rid of
every single ult that she ever tries,
Force Staff is a pretty good pick up
against Dawnbreaker. It lets you get out
of the circle before she lands from her
ultimate and lets you run away after she
throws out the hammer. Now Dazzle with
his ultimate is quite annoying, but one
of the interesting things about it is
that he cannot replicate consumable
items on the clone. As a result, if you
have a Glimmer Cape, you can use that
and even if the Dazzle bot dust, he
won't be able to use it during his ulti.
Death Prophet's Crypt Swarm is one of
the single best whoa, plague be upon
you, damage dealing spells in all of
Dota 2. Pick up an Infused Raindrops
early and the damage it deals won't feel
nearly as bad. As for our first BKB
hero, it's going to be Disruptor.
There's really not a whole lot of items
that can protect you from Glimpse and
Static Storm, but this is one of the
only ones that will. Just make sure to
pop it before he gets an Aghanim's
Scepter. Just kidding, he will get an
Aghs before you even knew that he was
building it and you will lose the game
as a result. Another classic counter,
Doom is the reason why none of the
jungle creeps' abilities break Linken's
Sphere. Buy this and then Doom will
become much less of a threat and he'll
have to buy a [ __ ] little item like
Heaven's Halberd or Force Staff or
something before he can even think about
using his ultimate. It's difficult to
counter John Dota with any particular
item. Dragon Knight's kit is very
well-rounded for a reason, but if I had
to put my money on something, it'd be
Manta Style. It allows you to dispel the
reduced right click damage from his Q
and if you're saucy like me, you can use
it to dodge his W during his ultimate.
Bonus armor is a very strange stat, but
if you're playing against Wraith Ranger,
you're going to need a lot of it.
Assault Cuirass not only gives you a ton
of bonus armor, but it also provides a
little bit to the rest of your team. If
you're playing against an Earth Spirit,
you can get away with a dispel,
something like a Manta or a Satanic, but
even if you pop that, there's a chance
that he just kicks you out of the fight.
So sadly he is the second BKB hero on
this list. Now there's a lot of items
that you can use to deal with
Earthshaker and something like a
pre-casted Orchid or Hex will go a long
way, but unfortunately that requires
having a modicum of skill. Consequently,
Guardian Greaves is an excellent pick
up. Earthshaker's ultimate doesn't
usually kill your team outright, but it
will get them low and Greaves will allow
you to continue fighting and may even be
the reason you didn't all die from that
grouped up five-man Echo Slam in the
first place. One of the big flaws of
Elder Titan is that his abilities all
require a bunch of wind up time. Astral
Spirit, you need to go around and
collect all the damage before you use
it. Astral Stomp has a massive cast
point. Eul's helps you with quite a bit
of that and a lot of people don't know
this, but the damage that you collect
from Astral Titan is actually
dispellable. Use this to interrupt Stomp

normal support should. Ember Spirit and
the rest of his spirit brothers all rely
on their spells for mobility. So if you
can take that away with an Orchid, you
can remind Ember that he is indeed a
squishy agi hero. When you're dealing
with an Enchantress, Silver Edge really
is the only option. I thought about
putting Dagon here because you can use
it to both kill her enchanted creeps and
deal magic damage to her, but let's be
real, she'll heal that up with Nature's
Attendants in like two and a half
seconds.
Difficult to deal with Black Hole and if
your team doesn't have a built-in
answer, the only real solution is Aeon
Disk. Use this and no matter how many

survive so you can watch the rest of
your team die as you get dogpiled

Oh look, it's Aeon Disk again. Something
about big purple team fight spells get
countered by this item. Grimstroke is
another hero who the majority of his kit
is unit target. So if you have a Lotus
Orb, it's going to be difficult for him
to do his thing. If you can reflect his
dead wife back onto him, that's very

Gyrocopter can deal an insane amount of

Another hero entirely reliant on his

Invoker's kit is a skill shot and that

Dispels can do a lot of work early on

You'll thank yourself later for buying

Oh, Juggernaut, pretty much every item

doesn't really mind picking up a

Kotl is a magic damage dealer who, in

I don't really know what KOTL does, but

He can hop on you. I You can You can get

Yeah.

Lifestealer relies on always having

observer ward to ping out that he has
it. And if your teammates die to it,
it's now their fault. Sand King does an
absurd amount of magical damage with his
ultimate, and now he can do composite
because of stinger. Still, if you're
able to pop pipe of insight during the
middle of epicenter, it'll go a long way
towards keeping your team alive, so he
has to right click you down instead.
Getting ulted by Shadow Demon
effectively means that you just have to
sit there and stand your ground because
any kind of defensive tool you have will
immediately get dispelled. But you know
what isn't dispellable? Satanic. If he
uses his queue, this means that you will
obviously have something to hit because
your clones will be beating your ass,
too. So once he uses his ulti, you just
pop satanic and wail on your own mirror
images until you either die or run out
of things to hit. Presence of the Dark
Lord does a ridiculous amount of armor
reduction, especially if he manages to
start snowballing, and a soul caress
will save you from getting three shot by
a caster. Blink hex on Shaman is
something that BKB will not save you
from, but even in such cases, the status
resistance from Sange and Yasha will
help you stay still for a little bit
less amount of time. When playing
against Silencer, it just comes down to
picking your favorite dispel. But manta
style is my favorite because you can use
the illusions to beat this dweeb's ass
even harder. Do not make the foolish
mistake of buying a glimmer cape against
Skywrath Mage. His ultimate does too
much damage and you'll die anyway.
Instead, get a force staff, and that way
you can get you or your dumbass
teammates out from under it. Playing
against Slardar, especially in current
patch, is guaranteed to be a pain in the
ass, but you can use Eul's Scepter to
make it slightly less so. You can
pre-cast an Anam to ruin his blink
initiation, and sprint is dispellable,
so you can get rid of that as well.
Ever since Valve reworked Leash to make
it so that you can no longer use force
staff against Slark, I've been
struggling to think of the perfect
counter. But then I realized that the
Slark is probably already put down all
of his sentries in order to deward you,
meaning that glimmer cape is ever so
slightly more valuable against him.
Why does Snapfire shotgun do that much
damage?
Seriously. Pick up infused raindrops,
you'll thank me later. Sniper's
assassinate has a ridiculous cast range
and does a solid amount of damage enough
to pick off most heroes at low HP, but
for some reason, if you pop a smoke of
deceit on the hero about to be
assassinated, the bullet won't land. A
lot of people throughout history could
have used this advice. Now, no matter
what items you go or what hero you're
playing, the Spectre will eventually be
forced to go a nullifier, but Eul's
remains relevant because you can use it
on both yourself and Spectre after she
jumps in on the illusion from haunt.
Now, if you ever see a Spirit Breaker
barreling towards you with Mark V with
Bulldoze on, go ahead and hit Eul's on
him. Not only will it cancel out the
charge, but it'll also dispel Bulldoze,
meaning that you may actually have the
opportunity to make him pay for his
crimes. Now, it's nowhere near as
shameful for a Storm Spirit to go BKB
than it is for a Puck to do it, but
still, he will feel a sense of regret
and remorse. Pick up an orchid as your
first or second item and make sure that
his BKB counter starts ticking down
starting in the early mid game. Now, for
Sven, I was originally going to put Aeon
Disk as the item you should go against
him, but then in demo mode, I discovered
that even if you're affected by Aeon
Disk, he can still cleave off of you,
which is very funny to me. Go a soul
caress instead, or butterfly if you can
afford it. Techies does an insane amount
of magic damage and his mines reduce
your magic resistance. Pipe will help
you counteract that and deal with the
impact of his suicide attack. Despite
her pitiful attack range at level one
possibly fooling you, TA is indeed a
ranged hero, and that means that
Heaven's Halberd will last the full 5
seconds while she has to sit there not
taking advantage of the meld armor she
just ripped off of you. Remember the
Terrorblade before the mid game is a
weak little B word, and that means that
any smoke gank aimed at him will
probably end in success, especially if
he foolishly chose to skip putting a
level in his ultimate. Now, ravage is a
strong ability, but the thing that
really makes Tide strong in the late
game is his sheer tankiness, especially
if he went the facet that buffs the
damage blocked by Kraken Shell. Pick up
a silver edge and his 70 damage block
suddenly vanishes into thin air and
makes this giant big fat [ __ ] actually
killable for once. Timbersaw's Aghanim's
Scepter will allow him to reach full
stacks of reactive armor and give him a
massive regenerating barrier that deals
damage when it explodes. To counter
this, Spirit Vessel is an excellent
choice because it deals damage as a
percentage of his current HP, chewing
down his barrier and preventing him from
dealing a Laguna Blade to everyone in
your back line. There are many items
that appear to counter Tinker on paper,
and then none of them freaking work, but
nullifier can actually do a decent job.
It'll dispel the shield, meaning that he
won't get the blink when it runs out,
which means that when you catch him, you
actually catch him this time. Man
fighting a Tiny doesn't usually end very
well, but satanic can help you get it
done. He's going to open up with his
spells and deal a ton of magic damage,
but if you can pop this item as soon as
he has to switch to right clicks,
there's a good chance that you can
outbox the rocks. Both leech seed and
overgrowth are dispellable, so if you're
playing against a Treant and he uses
both on you, just pop your dispel of
choice. In this case, I've used manta as
an example. With the press of one
button, you've now eliminated half of
his kit. Now, as an avid Troll Warlord
player, I can say that there is nothing
more frustrating on this hero than
popping your ultimate only to get hit by
a Eul's Scepter three times in a row.
Even if he gets a BKB, you can always
just use it on yourself. Tusk players
deserve to be punished for their crimes
of picking this hero, and one way that
you can make this happen is by waiting
for him to cast snowball on you and then
using force staff to get yourself deep
in the gooch of your tier threes. As a
result, he will die to your buildings,
and it's very funny. They keep making
Underlord Q deal more damage, so if you
use pipe of insight, it will feel like
it did 18 patches ago. Now, attack speed
is obviously a great thing to have
against Undying because it helps you
deal with the tombstone, but it's going
to be hard for your support duo to
slowly click it down if they're getting
mauled by the zombies. Pop crimson guard
and they're not going to take nearly as
much damage. Ursa can feel impossible to
kite during his ultimate because he gets
50% status resistance, so rod of atos,
basher, none of it really seems to do
anything. But notably, [clears throat]
Eul's Scepter ignores status resistance,
so he can spend his entire ultimate
twirling around in the air like a
dumbass. The cast range of Venge's
ultimate is almost double that of magic
missile, which means that she's going to
need to open up with it in every single
fight. Linken's Sphere prevents you from
trading places, and it also prevents her
from getting that giant damage shield
that, let's be honest, she probably
shouldn't even have in the first place.
As a dispel, Lotus Orb is automatically
going to be good against Venomancer, but
if he ever casts his ult on you while
you're Lotus Orb and suddenly
impregnates himself, it's going to be
very funny and leave him feeling very
upset cuz this hero already can't move
anyway. One of the funny things about
Viper ultimate is that you don't have to
manta dodge it. You just have to pop
manta while the projectile is in the air
and it just vanishes. I don't know why
it's like this, but hey, as long as it
is, take advantage of it. While Visage
himself can do a ridiculous amount of
magic damage, his little bird poopers
can really only deal physical. So if you
pop a crimson guard, his damage is going
to drop by a massive amount, especially
if it was owned by a high strength hero.
You aren't buying crimson guard on int
heroes, are you?
Void Spirit is a spirit. Spirits don't
like getting hit by orchid malevolence.
This is your final chance to learn this
lesson. Now, Lotus Orb doesn't actually
do that much against Warlock, but on the
off chance that he ever casts fatal
bonds on his own team, it seems to
somehow deal like triple the damage of a
normal fatal bonds, plus his team will
flame him. He might lose spirit, he
might start feeding for all you know, so
go ahead, take the chance, buy a Lotus
Orb and hope you roll high. Weaver is
not a spirit and bugs usually like
flowers, but in this case, orchid is an
amazing pick up against him. He'll have
to buy a defensive item, and that means
that he won't be able to two shot you
with Gemini that early in the game.
There are few things as funny as a
Windranger casting a royalty on you only
for you to pop blade mail, and you can
sense the fear in her as she attempts to
run away. But it's no use, she's already
sealed her own fate.
We all know that Winter Wyverns love to
just doddle around in the background not
doing anything in particular at the
start of a team fight waiting for a
five-man ulti. If you can blink on her,
the best she can hope for is a four-man
ulti, and in the best case scenario, you
kill her before she gets any ulti at
all. Fun fact about Witch Doctor ulti,
it actually gets bonus accuracy, meaning
that picking up sources of evasion won't
help you that much against it. However,
they are still somehow not right clicks,
but they're kind of like right clicks,
they're like physical attacks, but they
also deal pure. Ghost Scepter works,
just buy a ghost scepter against Witch
Doctor, trust me. Wraith King players
aren't smart enough to buy dust of
appearance, so if you go glimmer cape,
not only will it make him confused, but
it'll also trick his skellies into
running into a hellbear camp, getting
clapped on, and dying. Zeus deals magic
damage. Buy a pipe of insight.
I wrote a little bit here about Dota 2's
item design philosophy. Feel free to
read it if you like.
In conclusion, items are powerful, and
you should absolutely buy them. I have a
running tally of all the heroes that
I've won a game buying bloodthorn on.
Crystal Maiden is indeed one of those
heroes.
Peace on planet Earth.

# Guide to Hero Counters ## Thread Locked This thread has been locked by the moderators, you cannot reply to it. [Forum](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/forum) | | | |-|-| | [Permalink](https://www.dotafire.com/comment-link?comment_id=55000) |

[PM](https://www.dotafire.com/pm?r=create&recipients[]=NinjaMovesPro) |

by [NinjaMovesPro](https://www.dotafire.com/profile/ninjamovespro-3053)
»
January 13, 2014 9:58pm |
[Report](https://www.dotafire.com/report?relation_type=ForumThread&relation_id=4698)
There were already several guides about hero counters as I googled it but they were all drafts or not published. I've also discovered [dotahut.com](http://dotahut.com/) which presents this topic but it lacks even a single concise explanation why this hero counters that hero. This is one of the reason why I came in to this idea.
To give you a hint, this would be the guide looks like:
(This was written by me and a friend on Feb 2011 but was not posted in any dota forums.)
* * *
INTRODUCTION
In hero picking, I often pick heroes that would counter the opponent's heroes. I don't pick heroes just because they are strong. Having a line up that counters the opponent's main bread and butter won 90% of the time than just picking 'imbalanced heroes'.These are lists of some Counters for almost all Dota heroes. I wont say that these counters are the best. These are only suggestions on how you can counter heroes that you find hard to defeat. I'll be focusing on the heroes' skill disadvantage. Items, like BKB, linken, manta, etc, wont be considered. I will consider only some items that the heroes are really dependent upon like blink dagger for Earthshaker. But, the rest are heroes without defending items. These heroes are arranged alphabetically.
Abaddon, Lord of Avernus
Some Hero Counters for Abaddon:
1. Axe - Before Abaddon can trigger his borrowed time, axe can finish him off with Culling Blade.
2. Doom - Borrowed time wont be triggered while doomed
3. Lina - Perfect timing can kill Abaddon without letting him use his borrowed time
4. Lion - same reason with lina
5. Viper - simply slow him while he's using his borrowed time then finish him after
7. Heroes with hex, euls, or skadi
Aiushta - Enchantress
Some Hero Counters for Aiushta:
1. Bane Elemental - uses magical damage for Aiushta, Untouchable wont affect Bane for he is not doing normal attaks. Thus, when Aiushta uses her heal(nature's attendant), sleep her first.
2. Lion - Disable her before she got to use her heal
3. Zeus - he can have constant damage to Aiushta without having problem with Untouchable. With Aiushta's low hp, Zeus wont have any problem.
4. Lina - 1 combo, Aiushta's dead
5. Tinker - Spam spells then rearm
Aggron Stonebreaker, Ogre Magi
Some Hero Counters for Aggron Stonebreaker:
1. Omniknight - Repel serves a big problem for ogre magi
2. Bradwarden - Multicast can't kill heroes with High HP.
3. Necrolyte - Ogre Magi has high hp but with reaper, Necrolyte can kill him with ease.
4. Medusa - Aside from high hp of strength heroes, Medusa has mana shield that will make her hp not affected by multicast that much.
5. Nerubian Weaver - Weaver wont be killed by one multicast. After getting multicasted weaver can just use its time lapse and bring back its full hp.
6. Heroes with Defiance
Akasha, Queen of Pain
Some Hero Counters for Akasha:
1. Puck - silence wont make her blink or use her other skills making akasha vulnerable to death due to her low hp apparently.
2. Crystal Maiden - bite wont allow her to blink more than 3 secs.
3. Doom - Same reason with puck, silence.
4. Blood Seeker - Akasha wont blink while ruptured. If she does, the damage would be fatal and seeker will find her apparently because of thirst. Silence, also thus serves big problem for Akasha.
5. Lion - With lion's disabling ability, akasha will have a hard time escaping.
Anub'arak, Nerubian Assassin
Some Hero Counters for Anub'arak:
1. Puck - Vendetta is useless if Puck auto-activated its Phase Shift
2. Slardar - Invi heroes' worst nightmare
3. Low intelligence heroes - after the nerf made to anub'arak, low intelligence heroes wont be much affected by mana burn.
Anub'seran, Nerubian Weaver
Some Hero Counters for Anub'seran:
1. Lion - can finish anub'seran without letting him escape or use time lapse.
2. Slardar - Can chase Anub'seran's quick move speed and using Amplify Damage, there's no escape for Anub'seran.
3. Tiny - can finish Anub'seran in one combo
4. Doom - Anub'seran can't use his survival mechanisms when doomed.
5. Puck - silence and coil wont let him escape
Atropos, Bane Elemental
Some Hero Counters for Bane Elemental:
1. Pugna - Bane Elemental needs a lot of mana and Pugna's ward can damage him a lot.
2. Earthshaker - ES's long range of stun can waste his ulti
3. Tidehunter - Levi can wake up anytime within the length of sleep
4. Doom - will make an skill dependent, like bane, useless
5. Puck - silence or coil can easily disable atropos and waste his fiend's grip
Azwraith, Phantom Lancer
Some Hero Counters for Azwraith:
1. Slardar - AOE stun can detect who's real and amplify damage will make dopplewalk useless
2. Earthshaker - illusions help Earthshaker do more damage
3. Leshrak - Pulse Nova, Split earth, Lightning Storm are skills that can wipe out Azwraith illusions as well as him.
4. Lina - AOE spells can wipe out illusions and Laguna can wipe him out of the game.
5. Kunkka - can wipe out Azwraith's illusions having 3 skills that can do AOE, particularly his splash normal damage.
Balanar, Night Stalker
Some Hero Counters for Balanar:
1. Ezalor - Use mana drain on Balanar. With his fast move speed, he'll drain out of mana in no time.
2. Axe - has high hp and wont die of spamming void. Axe's counter helix will give more damage to Balanar while attacking him.
3. Bradwarden - Also a high hp hero. He wont die by spamming void. Attacking him will give more damage to Balanar too.
4. Necrolyte - Though he may be silenced, the silence duration wont make him die. Thus, Balanar's high hp is countered by Reaper's Scythe.
Banehallow, Lycanthrope
Some Hero Counters for Banehallow:
1. Strygwyr - rupture his 522 move speed.
2. Enigma - he can't escape from black hole
3. Rasta - shackles him to death
4. Bane Elemental - Grip him to death. Use enfeeble to make his normal attack useless.
5. Pugna - decrepify makes him or your allied heroes ghost and he wont be able to attack them.
6. Ursa - can deal more damage than Balanar in one on one situation
7. Ghost Scepter Heroes
Barathrum, Spiritbreaker
Some Hero Counters for Barathrum:
1. Pugna - Decrepify makes his ulti useless
2. Omniknight - Guardian Angel wont give you any damage too from his ulti
3. Any stunner - will make him useless in team fights if perfectly executed.
4. Necrolyte - strenght heroes' worst nightmare
5. Ghost Scepter Heroes
Black Arachnia, Broodmother
Some Hero Counters for Black Arachnia:
1. Dark Seer - ion shell and vacuum can both damage brood while inside the web. Surge when brood activates life steal. Dark seer makes brood mother a total trash.
2. Slardar - makes web useless
3. Earthshaker - has stronger ultimate because of the spiderlings
Boush, Tinker
Some Hero Counters for Boush:
1. Balanar - Balanar can survive a lane against tinker. Silence can make tinker run. Void will make you catch him. Void can cancel travel.
2. Doom - For silence purpose also, and canceling travel.
3. Blood Seeker - For silence too
4. Puck - For silence too and travel cancel. Dodge missile by using phase shift
Bone Clinkz, Bone Fletcher
Some Hero Counters for Bone Clinkz:
1. Slardar - makes windwalk useless
2. Pugna - Bone Clinkz is dependent on making normal attack for damage. Decrepify will make him do 0 damage for certain period of time.
3. Lion - Disable Bone Clinkz to death.
4. Ghost Scepter Heroes
Bradwarden, Centaur Warchief
Some Hero Counters for Bradwarden:
1. Necrolyte - Reaper for his High HP.
2. Venomancer - slowing him wont make him use dagger, it wont make him catch his opponent for stomp or double edge. Poison Nova eats his hp because the damage dealt is by hp percentage.
3. Viper - Brad can't touch viper because of massive slow.
Chen, Holy Knight
Some Hero Counters for Chen:
1. Earthshaker - Chen's creeps add to Echo Slam's damage.
2. Kunkka - With kunkka's massive AOE, Chen's creeps will be gone in no time.
3. POTM - Ganking heroes with escape mechanisms are quite difficult for chen.
4. Doom - Devour chen's creeps.
5. Enchantress - Enchant Chen's creep to have it your own.
Crixalis, Sand King
Some Hero Counters for Crixalis:
1. Silencer - Epicenter can easily be canceled by Silencer wherever silencer is. Furthermore, silencer's last word makes crixalis's impale epicenter combo impossible to be done.
2. Venge - Stun can cancel epicenter. Epicenter casted or not can be swapped away.
3. Lion - has disable for epicenter and ground stun for sand storm.
4. Batrider - Impale wont hit batrider while on firefly. Firefly does great damage making sandking run instead of using his sand storm. Flaming lasso also cancels epicenter.
5. Puck - silence cancels epicenter. Phase shift can dodge impale or epicenter.
Darchrow, Enigma
Some Hero Counters for Darchrow:
1. Silencer - Notrom can cancel his Black Hole anytime and anywhere as long as global silence is not on cool down. Last word wastes Black hole too.
2. Puck - silence or coil can cancel Black Hole. Be sure to use waning rift behind enigma for you not to be joining the Black Hole party.
3. Venge - Swap having long range can stop black hole anytime though Enigma has BKB.
4. Doom - cancels Black hole though Enigma activated BKB.
5. Earthshaker - Echo Slam will deal more damage because of Eilodons
Darkterror, Faceless Void
Some Hero Counters for Darkterror:
1. Omniknight - Guardian Angel makes Chrono Sphere useless for Darkterror. He can't damage anyone because he only relies on normal attack to deal damage.
2. Naga Siren - Sleep everyone after void used his Chrono Sphere.
3. Vengeful Spirit - Swap void away from Chronosphere to lessen the time he can attack freely.
4. Luna Moonfang - Void usually use his timewalk to chase or set fights. After using his time lapse to chase or set the fight, activate Eclipse. He'll be the one to die.
5. Ghost Scepter Heroes
Ezalor, Keeper of the Light
Some Hero Counters for Ezalor:
1. Vengeful Spirit - Since ezalor would be sniping his charge, swap him to prevent him from defending.
2. Zeus - Ezalor has low hp and spammers like zeus hurt him a lot. Thus, you can use wrath of god to cancel Ezalor's recall.
3. Naix - will eat ezalor's low HP. Rage wont be able to stop naix from eating Ezalor.
4. Strygwyr - Silence ezalor and rupture if he tries to run away
Furion, Prophet
Some Hero Counters for Furion:
1. Rikimaru - He won't be damaged from Furion's Wrath of Nature. He can blink strike out from Furion's sprout. He can silence Furion to cancel his teleportation skill.
2. Spectre - He can dagger out from furion's trees. He can chase furion if he teleports.
3. Earthshaker - More damage of echo slam because of force of nature skill.
4. Heroes with Orchid, tango, or Quelling Blade.
Gondar, Bounty Hunter
Some Hero Counters for Gondar:
1. Slardar - invi heroes' worst nightmare
2. Omniknight - he can remove Gondar's Ultimate-track.
3. Lion - wont allow him to escape having disables and a powerful nuke - Finger of Death.
4. Heroes with Gem
Harbringer, Obsidian Destroyer
Some Hero Counters for Harbringer:
1. Omniknight - use repel to avoid his deadly ultimate, his arcane orb, and Astral Imprisonment.
2. Lion - disable harbringer from doing much damage and to finish it off since it has very low hp.
3. Vengeful Spirit - One good counter to Harbringer is to swap him to your team mates to be able to focus fire on him. He can die in no time.
4. BKB heroes
Jah'rakal, Troll Warlord
Some Hero Counters for Jah'rakal:
1. Bane, Lion, Rasta, and other Disable heroes - Troll will eat you up if you don't have good disable.
2. Viper - If he uses rampage, viper strike can slow his attack and move speed.
3. Omniknight - Kill him while in guardian angel.
4. Harbringer - With Jah'rakal's low int, a high int Harbringer can finish him in once click.
Jakiro, Twin Headed Dragon
Some Hero Counters for Jakiro:
1. Pugna - Jakiro depends much on spamming to be of worth, thus Netherward can hurt him a lot.
2. Defiance/Pipe Heroes - Jakiro's Ultimate is a damage per second type of skill. Building defiance will reduce every damage that it's close to nothing.
3. BKB - Turn on your BKB then, he'd rely on giving normal attack to give damage.
4. Naix - with naix's rage and lifesteal, Jakiro can't hurt him. Thus naix is needed for Jakiro's moderate amount of HP, better than other int heroes.
Kardel Sharpeye, Dwarven Sniper
1. Barathrum - With kardel's low hp, a charging barathrum constantly bashing him and additional disable - Netherstrike, Kardel may die without even having the chance to use some of his bullets.
2. Phantom Lancer - With Azwraith's number of illusions, Kardel will take time to detect the real Phantom Lancer that he may be finished before he say GOTCHA! Azwraith's also a good counter for Kardel's long range. Backstabbing kardel is one of the best thing to do against him because if your going to walk towards him, he would use his range advantage along with his bashing gun shots to deal a lot of damage before you reach him.
3. Vengeful Spirit - Swap him to remove his range advantage
4. Blink Heroes - It is possible to dodge his ultimate by simply blinking with perfect timing.
5. BKB - can dodge his ultimate too, which I find incorrect, philosophically. Bullets should be treated as physical damage no matter what, but that's out of the topic.
Kel'Thuzard, Lich
1. Slardar - Amplify damage to lower lich's armor because of frost armor. Sprint to get out of chain frost which takes a long time to reach you. Sprint out from your allies for you to save them from bouncing frost.
2. Lycan - another fast moving hero that wont be much affected from nova and chain frost.
3. Harbringer - You can dodge chain frost by casting astral imprisonment on your self. Also, harbringer's arcane orb are magical attacks that goes through high armor.
4. Lina/Lion/Zeus - Take advantage of lich's low hp by spamming powerful nukes.
King Leoric, Skeleton King
1. Lion/Anub'arak/Magina - These are heroes that can counter your ultimate by draining your mana.
2. Diffusal Heroes - Heroes that will build diffusal can counter leoric by not letting him resurrect wasting his ultimate.
3. PL/Naga Siren/Manta Style heroes - Since leoric is a single target hero, you can use manta style to lessen his damage output potential.
Knight Davion, Dragon Knight
1. Harbringer - take advantage of Davion's low int. DK laning against Harbringer will be difficult for him to farm because of spamming Astral Imprisonment. Easy denying for harbringer and mana reduction for Davion makes him farm less.
2. Ursa - DK has high armor but still lower than roshan. If roshan is Ursa's favorite food DK would just be his appetizer.
3. Slardar - to reduce Davion's armor.
4. Naix - Naix can beat davion in a 1 on 1 situation because of Naix's lifesteal and quicker attack speed.
5. Traxex - Traxex has high damage output and can kill Davion easily in team fights not to mention Traxex's slowing ability to reduce potencials from Davion.
Krobelus, Death Prophet

There were already several guides about hero counters as I googled it but they were all drafts or not published. I've also discovered [dotahut.com](http://dotahut.com/) which presents this topic but it lacks even a single concise explanation why this hero counters that hero. This is one of the reason why I came in to this idea.
To give you a hint, this would be the guide looks like:
(This was written by me and a friend on Feb 2011 but was not posted in any dota forums.)
* * *
INTRODUCTION
In hero picking, I often pick heroes that would counter the opponent's heroes. I don't pick heroes just because they are strong. Having a line up that counters the opponent's main bread and butter won 90% of the time than just picking 'imbalanced heroes'.These are lists of some Counters for almost all Dota heroes. I wont say that these counters are the best. These are only suggestions on how you can counter heroes that you find hard to defeat. I'll be focusing on the heroes' skill disadvantage. Items, like BKB, linken, manta, etc, wont be considered. I will consider only some items that the heroes are really dependent upon like blink dagger for Earthshaker. But, the rest are heroes without defending items. These heroes are arranged alphabetically.
Abaddon, Lord of Avernus
Some Hero Counters for Abaddon:
1\. Axe - Before Abaddon can trigger his borrowed time, axe can finish him off with Culling Blade.
2\. Doom - Borrowed time wont be triggered while doomed
3\. Lina - Perfect timing can kill Abaddon without letting him use his borrowed time
4\. Lion - same reason with lina
5\. Viper - simply slow him while he's using his borrowed time then finish him after
7\. Heroes with hex, euls, or skadi
Aiushta - Enchantress
Some Hero Counters for Aiushta:
1\. Bane Elemental - uses magical damage for Aiushta, Untouchable wont affect Bane for he is not doing normal attaks. Thus, when Aiushta uses her heal(nature's attendant), sleep her first.
2\. Lion - Disable her before she got to use her heal
3\. Zeus - he can have constant damage to Aiushta without having problem with Untouchable. With Aiushta's low hp, Zeus wont have any problem.
4\. Lina - 1 combo, Aiushta's dead
5\. Tinker - Spam spells then rearm
Aggron Stonebreaker, Ogre Magi
Some Hero Counters for Aggron Stonebreaker:
1\. Omniknight - Repel serves a big problem for ogre magi
2\. Bradwarden - Multicast can't kill heroes with High HP.
3\. Necrolyte - Ogre Magi has high hp but with reaper, Necrolyte can kill him with ease.
4\. Medusa - Aside from high hp of strength heroes, Medusa has mana shield that will make her hp not affected by multicast that much.
5\. Nerubian Weaver - Weaver wont be killed by one multicast. After getting multicasted weaver can just use its time lapse and bring back its full hp.
6\. Heroes with Defiance
Akasha, Queen of Pain
Some Hero Counters for Akasha:
1\. Puck - silence wont make her blink or use her other skills making akasha vulnerable to death due to her low hp apparently.
2\. Crystal Maiden - bite wont allow her to blink more than 3 secs.
3\. Doom - Same reason with puck, silence.
4\. Blood Seeker - Akasha wont blink while ruptured. If she does, the damage would be fatal and seeker will find her apparently because of thirst. Silence, also thus serves big problem for Akasha.
5\. Lion - With lion's disabling ability, akasha will have a hard time escaping.
Anub'arak, Nerubian Assassin
Some Hero Counters for Anub'arak:
1\. Puck - Vendetta is useless if Puck auto-activated its Phase Shift
2\. Slardar - Invi heroes' worst nightmare
3\. Low intelligence heroes - after the nerf made to anub'arak, low intelligence heroes wont be much affected by mana burn.
Anub'seran, Nerubian Weaver
Some Hero Counters for Anub'seran:
1\. Lion - can finish anub'seran without letting him escape or use time lapse.
2\. Slardar - Can chase Anub'seran's quick move speed and using Amplify Damage, there's no escape for Anub'seran.
3\. Tiny - can finish Anub'seran in one combo
4\. Doom - Anub'seran can't use his survival mechanisms when doomed.
5\. Puck - silence and coil wont let him escape
Atropos, Bane Elemental
Some Hero Counters for Bane Elemental:
1\. Pugna - Bane Elemental needs a lot of mana and Pugna's ward can damage him a lot.
2\. Earthshaker - ES's long range of stun can waste his ulti
3\. Tidehunter - Levi can wake up anytime within the length of sleep
4\. Doom - will make an skill dependent, like bane, useless
5\. Puck - silence or coil can easily disable atropos and waste his fiend's grip
Azwraith, Phantom Lancer
Some Hero Counters for Azwraith:
1\. Slardar - AOE stun can detect who's real and amplify damage will make dopplewalk useless
2\. Earthshaker - illusions help Earthshaker do more damage
3\. Leshrak - Pulse Nova, Split earth, Lightning Storm are skills that can wipe out Azwraith illusions as well as him.
4\. Lina - AOE spells can wipe out illusions and Laguna can wipe him out of the game.
5\. Kunkka - can wipe out Azwraith's illusions having 3 skills that can do AOE, particularly his splash normal damage.
Balanar, Night Stalker
Some Hero Counters for Balanar:
1\. Ezalor - Use mana drain on Balanar. With his fast move speed, he'll drain out of mana in no time.
2\. Axe - has high hp and wont die of spamming void. Axe's counter helix will give more damage to Balanar while attacking him.
3\. Bradwarden - Also a high hp hero. He wont die by spamming void. Attacking him will give more damage to Balanar too.
4\. Necrolyte - Though he may be silenced, the silence duration wont make him die. Thus, Balanar's high hp is countered by Reaper's Scythe.
Banehallow, Lycanthrope
Some Hero Counters for Banehallow:
1\. Strygwyr - rupture his 522 move speed.
2\. Enigma - he can't escape from black hole
3\. Rasta - shackles him to death
4\. Bane Elemental - Grip him to death. Use enfeeble to make his normal attack useless.
5\. Pugna - decrepify makes him or your allied heroes ghost and he wont be able to attack them.
6\. Ursa - can deal more damage than Balanar in one on one situation
7\. Ghost Scepter Heroes
Barathrum, Spiritbreaker
Some Hero Counters for Barathrum:
1\. Pugna - Decrepify makes his ulti useless
2\. Omniknight - Guardian Angel wont give you any damage too from his ulti
3\. Any stunner - will make him useless in team fights if perfectly executed.
4\. Necrolyte - strenght heroes' worst nightmare
5\. Ghost Scepter Heroes
Black Arachnia, Broodmother
Some Hero Counters for Black Arachnia:
1\. Dark Seer - ion shell and vacuum can both damage brood while inside the web. Surge when brood activates life steal. Dark seer makes brood mother a total trash.
2\. Slardar - makes web useless
3\. Earthshaker - has stronger ultimate because of the spiderlings
Boush, Tinker
Some Hero Counters for Boush:
1\. Balanar - Balanar can survive a lane against tinker. Silence can make tinker run. Void will make you catch him. Void can cancel travel.
2\. Doom - For silence purpose also, and canceling travel.
3\. Blood Seeker - For silence too
4\. Puck - For silence too and travel cancel. Dodge missile by using phase shift
Bone Clinkz, Bone Fletcher
Some Hero Counters for Bone Clinkz:
1\. Slardar - makes windwalk useless
2\. Pugna - Bone Clinkz is dependent on making normal attack for damage. Decrepify will make him do 0 damage for certain period of time.
3\. Lion - Disable Bone Clinkz to death.
4\. Ghost Scepter Heroes
Bradwarden, Centaur Warchief

**Items** are in-game equipment that provide [heroes](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes") with bonus attributes and special abilities. Most items can be purchased from several shops on the [game map](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Game_map "Game map"), while others are dropped by [creeps](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Creeps "Creeps"). Lower tier items are combined into higher tier items, usually with the help of a [recipe](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Recipe "Recipe"). Heroes have six item slots in their [inventory](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Inventory "Inventory"), three in their [backpack](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Backpack "Backpack"), and six more in their [stash](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Stash "Stash"). Items can be picked up and delivered to their owner with a [courier](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Courier "Courier").

## Non-purchasable Items

### Neutral Items

Main Article: [Neutral Items](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Neutral_Items "Neutral Items")

**Neutral items** are **items** obtained through tokens that are dropped by [neutral creeps](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Neutral_creeps "Neutral creeps"). They cannot be purchased or sold at shops and cannot be destroyed.

Each player may equip only one neutral item in a dedicated neutral item slot. Unused neutral items can be put in the dedicated stash within the fountain.

## Event Items

Main Article: [Items/Event Items](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Items/Event_Items "Items/Event Items")

These items were only available during limited time events or had an account bound limited amount of uses. Besides the river vials, all of these items got removed from the game files and are no longer functioning and can no longer be created with [cheats](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Cheats "Cheats") in custom lobbies. The river vials, although still within the game, can no longer be acquired or used, as they expired.

## Shops

[![Locations of all the shops.](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dota2_gamepedia/images/2/2e/Shop_locations.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/180?cb=20230521154406)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dota2_gamepedia/images/2/2e/Shop_locations.png/revision/latest?cb=20230521154406)

Locations of all the shops.

There are two different shops per [faction](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Faction "Faction"). The [Base Shop](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Base_Shop "Base Shop") and the [Secret Shop](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Secret_Shop "Secret Shop"). In the shop areas, items can be swapped from the [backpack](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Backpack "Backpack") without time penalty.

### Base Shop

Main Article: [Base Shop](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Base_Shop "Base Shop")

The Base Shops are located within the [Fountain](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Fountain "Fountain") are behind the [Ancients](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Ancient_(Building) "Ancient (Building)"). All basic items except the secret ones can be bought there. Additionally a majority of the upgrades can be completed there.

### Secret Shop

Main Article: [Secret Shop](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Secret_Shop "Secret Shop")

The Secret Shops are slightly hidden shops located near the center of the map. The shops allow players to buy items that cannot be bought elsewhere or to spend extra [gold](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Gold "Gold") while in the early game.

### Removed Shops

#### Side Lane Shop

Main Article: [Side Lane Shop](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Side_Lane_Shop "Side Lane Shop")

Two Side Lane Shops were shops that could be found at the edges of the map. They allowed players to buy certain useful items without returning to base or to the secret shops. All side shops have been removed from the game in [7.23](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/7.23 "7.23") update.

## Other information

- Heroes cannot use items owned by other heroes, with a handful of exceptions. See [Item Sharing](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Item_Sharing "Item Sharing") for details.
- Some items can be disassembled. See [Disassemble](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Disassemble "Disassemble") for details.
- Most items may be sold back to vendors. See [Selling](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Selling "Selling") for details.
- Most dropped items can be destroyed by force-attacking (`A`) them.

  - Allies' items which are not flagged as [shareable](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Item_sharing "Item sharing") cannot be destroyed.
  - [![Gem of True Sight icon](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dota2_gamepedia/images/1/1d/Gem_of_True_Sight_icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/20?cb=20160530170545)](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Gem_of_True_Sight "Gem of True Sight")[Gem of True Sight](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Gem_of_True_Sight "Gem of True Sight") and [![Divine Rapier icon](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dota2_gamepedia/images/b/b1/Divine_Rapier_icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/20?cb=20160530165837)](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Divine_Rapier "Divine Rapier")[Divine Rapier](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Divine_Rapier "Divine Rapier") cannot be destroyed.
- The range for dropping an item on the ground is 100.
- The range for picking up an item from the ground is 150.
- The range for transfering an item to another unit is 300.
- Most item effects cannot be effectively stacked with multiple copies of the same item on a single hero, with the copy only being able to provide the base stats of the item.
  - Cooldowns are shared between identical items with active abilities, and if one item with an active ability can be upgraded into another, most of the time both will share a cooldown.
  - Multiple instances of the same aura or debuff will not stack, even if the two copies of the item providing it are owned by separate heroes.
- Some items do not provide their effect to heroes with passive abilities providing the same or similar effect. For example, most heroes with a [bash](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Bash "Bash") ability cannot use the passive ability from [![Skull Basher icon](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dota2_gamepedia/images/9/9d/Skull_Basher_icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/20?cb=20160530173357)](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Skull_Basher "Skull Basher")[Skull Basher](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Skull_Basher "Skull Basher").
- Some items have effects that only apply to heroes that are [ranged](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Ranged "Ranged") or [melee](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Melee "Melee").
- When combining one item from multiple items, the resulting item will attempt to be placed in the inventory slot of the component that has the most similar active effect.
  - For example, [![Magic Wand icon](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dota2_gamepedia/images/7/74/Magic_Wand_icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/20?cb=20160829124055)](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Magic_Wand "Magic Wand")[Magic Wand](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Magic_Wand "Magic Wand") will combine in [![Magic Stick icon](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dota2_gamepedia/images/5/59/Magic_Stick_icon.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/20?cb=20160530171235)](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Magic_Stick "Magic Stick")[Magic Stick](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Magic_Stick "Magic Stick")'s inventory slot.
- The shop at the enemy fountain can also be used to buy items, sell items, and access the stash.
  - The Secret Shops have a restricted inventory, and cannot be used to access the hero's stash.

# Complete Dota 2 Item Guide with Strategies and Stats – Patch 7.41d

Heroes can equip Items that augment and improve their attributes and Abilities. In this way, Items can change how a Hero is played.

Items can be purchased with Gold from the Shopkeeper located in each team's Fountain.

Some Items can be consumed to replenish a Hero's Health and Mana.

Many powerful Items may only be purchased at two Secret Shops, which are located deeper within the Map.

Items you purchase can often be used as components in Recipes, which can then be combined into powerful upgraded Items. Upgraded Items can also be sold back to the Shopkeeper for half of their original purchase price.

## Shop Items

Items are vital in-game equipment that imbue your hero with extra attribute bonuses and special abilities. Use gold to purchase items from multiple shops around the map. Basic items often combine into high-tier upgrades, many of which require a recipe. Each hero has six main item slots in their inventory, three backpack slots, and six more in their stash. Players can ferry items around the map for delivery with a courier.

## Neutral Items

Heroes can also use Neutral Items -- special items unavailable for purchase that are instead crafted using Madstone. Clear creep camps to harvest Madstone for yourself and a random teammate. Once you've got enough, choose a custom combo from a list of Artifacts and Enchantments to craft the perfect item to fit the state of any game. Unlike normal items, Neutral Items cannot be destroyed. Each player has one dedicated slot available for a Neutral Item.

## Item Strategy

Before buying items consider your hero's role. Some heroes are more
suited to offensive items, while others are better suited to defensive
items. Think about the needs of your team. If your team is lacking in
damage, you may want to purchase an offensive item. If your team is
struggling to survive, you may want to purchase a defensive item. Be
aware of the enemy team's composition. If the enemy team has a lot of
magic damage, you may want to purchase items that increase your magical
resistance. If the enemy team has a lot of physical damage, you may want
to purchase items that increase your physical resistance. Don't be
afraid to experiment. There is no one right way to build a hero in Dota
2\. Try different items and see what works best for you and your team.
